BEB-5653 PARK-NOT-RETRY = DEPLOYED (mastra 5779faa1, live/index.js ~2867). Not yet ACCEPTED (next tick proves it).
WHAT: in the hand-route SPECOPS_NO_CONTRACT block, when spec_author REFUSES (SPEC_ASK), the ticket is now PARKED to backlog (invisible to the dispatcher -> stops the re-queue-to-complete storm) + a comment names the human decision (reword ## Acceptance to grounded assertions, then flip to todo). Auto-fixer does NOT rewrite acceptance = judgement stays human (m66358).
IDEMPOTENT: gated by the existing dayKey is_real routing row -> runs once per ticket per day; setting backlog twice is a no-op (m66357 law).
REVERSIBLE: a human tightens acceptance -> todo.
ACCEPTANCE (next wake): BEB-6177 (2466x/24h) + peers hit SPEC_ASK -> land in backlog, not re-queued; complete-stage failure volume drops. Will confirm on the tick.
NEXT cc-do: BEB-5767 spec mint.

BEB-6860 SPLIT IDEMPOTENT — real block on Part 1, need a pointer.
FINDING: the dupes are LIVE and ongoing. Parent BEB-3582 section "LITERAL ON-PAGE STRINGS" has 20 children, all status=todo, created 2026-08-22 through TODAY (BEB-4059 oldest … BEB-6598 latest). Same for THE PAGE ×3 etc.
BUT the in-tree auto-splitter (abilifi-dispatcher runSplit ~line 4093) is NOT the culprit: it titles children `${parent.number}${letter}: ${label}` (e.g. "3582a: …") AND already has two idempotency guards — priorSplit row `SPLIT:${ticket}` (4063) parks the parent after one split, and a search-before-file title dedup (4077). Those work.
The dupes use a DIFFERENT title format: `BEB-3582 · <SECTION> — the contract…`. That `·`-joined title is minted by a path I cannot find in abilifi-dispatcher OR abilifi-mastra (grepped create_issue + the · char). Likely candidates: the REFINE step's model output (a model authoring "refined child tickets" free-hand), or a worker not in this tree.
NEED: Fable/Alex — where is the `BEB-N · SECTION` child mint? Once located I add the parent+section idempotency there (search-before-file, return existing, mint nothing).
PART 2 (cleanup) I CAN do now without the mint path: per parent+section keep the OLDEST child (BEB-4059), cancel the rest with a comment naming the survivor (cancel, not delete). Say go and I sweep 3582 + the other duplicated sections, reporting count before/after. Holding on the bulk-cancel until you confirm — it is ~40+ tickets.

CC — THE CHILD BODIES NAME THE CULPRIT. It is not the splitter, it is a BINDING-FIXER
Every dupe says "Binding inherited from the parent so the child is claimable (was BINDING_UNRESOLVABLE)". That is a REPAIR note. Something finds unresolvable children and RE-MINTS them with binding instead of PATCHING them. Grep that sentence, not the · character. Check BEB-2967's implementation and anything handling BINDING_UNRESOLVABLE.

AND THE TELL THAT CONFIRMS IT: the OLDEST children (4063, 4512) have NO inheritance sentence — they say only "Lane: BUILD"
Those are generation one. Everything carrying the inheritance sentence is a re-mint. So the fix is the same shape as 5653: REPAIR BY EDITING THE ROW, never by minting a new one.

PART 2 CLEANUP — GO. Sweep it, with three guards
1 Keep the OLDEST per parent+section; CANCEL the rest naming the survivor. 2 NEVER cancel a child that is in_progress or carries evidence/a contract run — skip and list it. 3 Report count before and after, per parent+section. 40+ is fine; it is 40 copies of six things.
DIRECTIVE 66367 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-6860, BEB-3582, BEB-6808 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.
WATCHDOG DIFF (BEB-3622): claims fell N→N (claim path stopped) — out-of-band, surfaced not blocking.
WATCHDOG APP_HOST_REVIEW: 2/11 surfaces blank or dead — /home?cb=2026-08-29(404,290c) · /health(200,62c)
ELIGIBILITY INVARIANT VIOLATED (BEB-2690 §3, asserted from outside the dispatcher): the split accounts for ZERO tickets — a pass that sees nothing reports the same shape as a healthy one
